title: Keep production secrets out of pull-request CI jobs
why: site-quality.yml runs on pull_request with secrets.DATABASE_URL, so a same-repository branch runs its own code with the production database credential before review. This blocks scheduling the CTO executor routine (frontend/prompts/CLAUDE_CTO_EXECUTOR.md).
definition_of_done: No job triggered by pull_request references a production secret; database-backed checks run only after merge or by manual dispatch.
verify: No workflow job reachable from a pull_request trigger references secrets.DATABASE_URL.
